title: 中证数智企业数据配置
description: 连接中证数智数据平台，用于查询企业工商、司法、财务、舆情等数据。API Key 仅存储在本机 ~/.workbuddy 下，不会上传云端。
description_en: Connect to the CSCS data platform to query enterprise registration, legal, financial, and news data. Your API Key is stored locally in ~/.workbuddy only.
